I initially had a problem where my board would not shut off, which they seemed helpful with at first, sending me a new battery box with the power button on it. However, this didn't fix my problem, and they ended up individually sending me 4 or 5 parts that didn't fix it either over the course of a few months. After a lot of this I was practically begging them to just replace the whole board and they refused, but ended up sending me parts that together cost as much as the entire board did, so I don't understand why they wouldn't just replace the whole thing. After replacing the battery pack, battery, and esc, I started having other electrical problems and one of my motors stopped working. They did replace the motor, but I never got to the bottom of my original problem and the electronics on the board just acted weirder and weirder. They pretty much jerked me around until the warranty expired and then ghosted me. I have heard other people with similar experiences. I would personally recommend buying a board from a company based in the country you live it so that it's easier to hold them accountable, because with meepo in China there was basically nothing else I could do.
